description: Payment charge without idempotency key — should block
design: On button click, POST /api/charge with the stored card token and amount. Retry on network failure up to 3 times.

oracle_evidence.key_insight: Payment charges without idempotency keys caused duplicate charges during network retries
oracle_evidence.decision: All payment charge requests must include a Stripe idempotency key — retries without idempotency keys caused duplicate charges in production
